1.1: Kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom, moalim bahen. shechatan baddarom vekibbel daman batztzafon, batztzafon vekibbel daman baddarom, shechatan bayyom vezarak ballayla, ballayla vezarak bayyom, o sheshshechatan chutz lizmannan vechutz limkoman, moalin bahen. kelal amar rabbi yehoshua, kol shehaya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim, en moalin bah. veshello haya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim, moalin bah. ezo hi shehaya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim. shellana, veshennitmea, vesheyyatza. ezo hi shello haya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim. shennishchata chutz lizmannah, chutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu fesulin vezarku et damah:
1.2: Besar kadshe kadashim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim, rabbi eliezer omer, moalin bo, veen chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame. rabbi akiva omer, en moalin bo, aval chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame. amar rabbi akiva, vahare hammafrish chattat veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shetehen omdot, lo cheshem sheddamah poter et besarah, kach hu foter et besar chavertah. veim patar damah et besar chavertah min hammeila, din hu sheyyiftor et besarah:
1.3: Emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim, rabbi eliezer omer, en moalin bahen, veen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul notar vetame. rabbi akiva omer, moalin bahen, vechayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame:
1.4: Maase damim bekadshe kadashim, lehakel ulehachamir. uvekadashim kallim, kullan lehachamir. ketzad. kadshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim, moalin baemurin uvabbasar. leachar zerikat damim, moalim baemurim veen moalin babbasar. al ze veal ze, chayyavin mishshum piggul, notar vetame. uvekadashim kallim kullan lehachamir. ketzad. kadashim kallim lifne zerikat damim, en moalin lo vaemurin velo vabbasar. leachar zerikat damim, moalin baemurin veen moalin babbasar. al ze veal ze, chayyavin mishshum piggul, notar vetame. nimtza maase damim bekadshe kadashim, lehakel ulehachamir. uvekadashim kallim, kullo lehachamir:

2.1: Chattat haof, moalin bah mishshehukdesha. nimleka, huchshera lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. huzza damah, chayyavin aleha mishshum piggul, notar vetame, veen bah meila:
2.2: Olat haof, moalin bah mishshehukdesha. nimleka, huchshera lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. mitztza damah, chayyavin aleha mishshum piggul, notar vetame. umoalin bah ad shettetze levet haddashen:
2.3: Parim hannisrafin useirim hannisrafin, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. nishchatu, huchsheru lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. huzza daman, chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame. umoalin bahen bevet haddeshen ad sheyyuttach habbasar:
2.4: Haola, moalin bah mishshehukdesha. nishchata, huchshera lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. nizrak damah, chayyavin aleha mishshum piggul, notar vetame. veen moalin beorah, aval moalin babbasar ad sheyyetze levet haddashen:
2.5: Chattat veasham vezivche shalme tzibbur, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. nishchatu, huchsheru lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. nizrak daman, chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, notar vetame. en moalin babbasar, aval moalin baemurim ad sheyyetzu levet haddashen:
2.6: Shete hallechem, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. karmu vattannur, huchsheru lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim velishchot alehem et hazzavach. nizrak daman shel kevasim, chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame, veen bahen meila:
2.7: Lechem happanim, moalin bo mishshehukdash. karam battannur, huchshar lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim, ulehissader al gabbe hashshulchan. karvu habbezichin, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame, veen bahen meila:
2.8: Hammenachot, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. kadshu vakkeli, huchsheru lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. karav hakkometz, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame. veen moalin bashsheyarim, aval moalim bakkometz ad sheyyetze levet haddashen:
2.9: Hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, umenachot kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachin, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. kadshu vakkeli, huchsheru lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina, vechayyavin alehen mishshum notar umishshum tame, ufiggul en bahen. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyesh lo mattirin, en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame, ad sheyyikrevu mattirav. vechol sheen lo mattirin, kevan shekkadash bakkeli, chayyavin alav mishshum notar umishshum tame, ufiggul en bo:

3.1: Velad chattat utemurat chattat vechattat shemmetu vealeha, yamutu. sheavra shenatah, vesheavda veshennimtzet baalat mum, im mishshekkipperu habbealim, tamut, veenah osa temura, velo nehenim, velo moalin. veim ad shello chipperu habbealim, tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher, veyavi vedameha acheret, veosa temura, umoalim bah:
3.2: Hammafrish maot linziruto, lo nehenin velo moalin, mippene shehen reuyin lavo chullan shelamim. met, hayu setumim, yippelu lindava. hayu meforashim, deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach, lo nehenim velo moalin bahen. deme ola, yaviu ola umoalin bahen. udeme shelamim, yaviu shelamim, veneechalim leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem:
3.3: Rabbi yishmael omer, haddam, kal bitchillato vechamur besofo, vehannesachim, chomer bitchillatan vekal besofan. haddam, battechilla en moalim bo. yatza lenachal kidron, moalim bo. hannesachim, battechilla moalim bahen. yatzu lashshitin, en moalim bahem:
3.4: Dishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora, lo nehenin velo moalin. hammakdish dishshun battechilla, moalim bo. torim shello higgia zemannan, uvene yona sheavar zemannan, lo nehenim velo moalim. rabbi shimon omer, torin shello higgia zemannan, moalin bahen. uvene yona sheavar zemannan, lo nehenin velo moalin:
3.5: Chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin, lo nehenin velo moalim. bamme devarim amurim, bekadshe mizbeach. aval bekadshe vedek habbayit, hikdish tarnegolet, moalin bah uvevetzatah. chamor, moalin bah uvachalavah:
3.6: Kol harauy lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit, levedek habbayit velo lammizbeach, lo lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit, moalin bo. ketzad, hikdish bor male mayim, ashpa melea zevel, shovach male yonim, ilan male ferot, sade melea asavim, moalin bahem uvema shebbetochan. aval im hikdish bor veachar kach nitmalle mayim, ashpa veachar kach nitmala zevel, shovach veachar kach nitmalle yonim, ilan veachar kach nitmalle ferot, sade veachar kach nitmala asavim, moalin bahen, veen moalin bema shebbetochan, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi shimon omer, hammakdish sade veilan, moalin bahem uvegiddulehem, mippene shehen giddule hekdesh. velad meusseret lo yinak min hameusseret. vaacherim mitnaddevim ken. velad mukdashin lo yinak min hammukdashin. vaacherim mitnaddevim ken. happoalim lo yochlu miggerogarot shel hekdesh. vechen para lo tochal mikkarshine hekdesh:
3.7: Sharshe ilan shel hedyot bain beshel hekdesh veshel hekdesh bain beshel hedyot, lo nehenin velo moalin. hammayan shehu yotze mittoch sede hekdesh, lo nehenin velo moalin. yatza chutz lassade, nehenin mimmennu. hammayim shebbechad shel zahav, lo nehenin velo moalin. nittenu vitzlochit, moalin bahem. arava, lo nehenin velo moalin. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer, notnin hayu mimmenna zekenim belulevehem:
3.8: Ken shebberosh hailan shel hekdesh, lo nehenin velo moalin. shebbaashera, yattiz bekane. hammakdish et hachoresh, moalin bechullo. haggizbarim shellakchu et haetzim, moalin baetzim, veen moalin lo vashshippuy velo vanneviyya:

4.1: Kadshe hammizbeach mitztarfin ze im ze limila, ulechayyev alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame. kadshe vedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze. kadshe hammizbeach vekadshe vedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze limila:
4.2: Chamishsha devarim baola mitztarfin ze im ze. habbasar, vehachelev, vehassolet, vehayyayin, vehashshamen. veshishsha battoda. habbasar, vehachelev, vehassolet, vehayyayin, vehashshemen, vehallachem. hatteruma, uterumat maaser, uterumat maaser shel demay, hachalla, vehabbikkurim, mitztarfin ze im ze leesor ulechayyev alehen et hachomesh:
4.3: Kol happiggulin mitztarfin ze im ze. kol hannotarin mitztarfin ze im ze. kol hannevelot mitztarfot zo im zo. kol hashsheratzim mitztarfin ze im ze. dam hashsheretz uvesaro mitztarfin. kelal amar rabbi yehoshua, kol shettumato veshiuro shavin, mitztarfin ze im ze. tumato velo shiuro, shiuro velo tumato, lo tumato velo shiuro, en mitztarfin ze im ze:
4.4: Happiggul vehannotar en mitztarfin ze im ze, mippene shehem shene shemot. hashsheretz vehannevela, vechen hannevela uvesar hammet, en mitztarfin ze im ze letamme afillu chakkal shebbishnehem. haochel shennitma veav hattuma veshennitma vivlad hattuma, mitztarfin ze im ze letamme chakkal shebbishnehem:
4.5: Kol hoochalin mitztarfin, lifsol et haggeviyya vechachatzi feras, bimzon shete seuddot laeruv, bechabbetza letamme tumat ochalin, bechaggerogeret lehotzaat shabbat, bechakkotevet beyom hakkippurim. kol hammashkin mitztarfin, lifsol et haggeviyya virviit, uvimlo lugmav beyom hakkippurim:
4.6: Haarla vechile hakkerem mitztarfin ze im ze. rabbi shimon omer, enan mitztarfin. habbeged vehassak, hassak vehaor, haor vehammappatz, mitztarfin ze im ze. rabbi shimon omer, mippene shehen reuyin littamme moshav:

5.1: Hannehene shave feruta min hahekdesh, af al pi shello fagam, maal, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, kol davar sheyesh bo fegam, lo maal ad sheyyifgom. vechol davar sheen bo fegam, kevan shennehena, maal. ketzad. natna katla vetzavvarah, tabbaat beyadah, shatta vechos shel zahav, kevan shennehenet, maala. lavash bechaluk, kissa vetallit, bikka bekurdom, lo maal ad sheyyifgom. talash min hachattat keshehi chayya, lo maal ad sheyyifgom. keshehi meta, kevan shennehena, maal:
5.2: Nehena vechachatzi feruta ufagam bechachatzi feruta, o shennehena veshave feruta bedavar echad ufagam beshave feruta bedavar acher, hare ze lo maal, ad shennehene veshave feruta veyifgom beshave feruta bedavar echad:
5.3: En moel achar moel bammukdashin, ella vehema uchele sharet. ketzad. rachav al gabbe vehema uva chavero verachav uva chavero verachav, shata vechos shel zahav uva chavero veshata uva chavero veshata, talash min hachattat uva chavero vetalash uva chavero vetalash, kullan maalu. rabbi omer, kol sheen lo fidyon, yesh bo moel achar moel:
5.4: Natal even o kora shel hekdesh, hare ze lo maal. netanah lachavero, hu maal vachavero lo maal. benaah betoch beto, hare ze lo maal, ad sheyyadur tachteha beshave feruta. natal peruta shel hekdesh, hare ze lo maal. netanah lachavero, hu maal vachavero lo maal. netanah labballan, af al pi shello rachatz, maal, shehu omer lo, hare merchatz petucha, hikkanes urechotz:
5.5: Achilato vaachilat chavero, hanayato vahanayat chavero, achilato vahanayat chavero, hanayato vaachilat chavero, mitztarfin ze im ze, vaafillu lizman merubbe:

6.1: Hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto, baal habbayit maal. lo asa shelichuto, hashshaliach maal. ketzad. amar lo, ten basar laorchim venatan lahem kaved, kaved venatan lahem basar, hashshaliach maal. amar lo, ten lahem chaticha chaticha, vehu amar tolu shetayim shetayim, vehem natlu shalosh shalosh, kullan maalu. amar lo, have li min hachallon o miggeluskema, vehevi lo, af al pi sheamar baal habbayit lo haya velibbi ella mizze vehevi mizze, baal habbayit maal. aval im amar lo, have li min hachallon vehevi lo miggeluskema, o min geluskema vehevi lo min hachallon, hashshaliach maal:
6.2: Shalach beyad cheresh, shote, vekatan, im asu shelichuto, baal habbayit maal. lo asu shelichuto, hachenvani maal. shalach beyad pikkeach, venizkar ad shello higgia etzel hachenvani, hachenvani maal kesheyyotzi. ketzad yaase. notel peruta o cheli veyomar, peruta shel hekdesh bechol makom shehi, mechullelet al ze, shehahekdesh nifde vechesef uveshave chasef:
6.3: Natan lo feruta, amar lo, have li vechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot, halach vehevi lo vechullah nerot o vechullah petilot, o sheamar lo, have li vechullah nerot o vechullah petilot, halach vehevi lo vechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot, shenehem lo maalu. aval im amar lo, have li vechetzyah nerot mimmakom peloni uvechetzyah petilot mimmakom peloni, vehalach vehevi lo nerot mibbet petilot ufetilot mibbet nerot, hashshaliach maal:
6.4: Natan lo shete ferutot, amar lo, have li etrog, vehalach vehevi lo vifruta etrog uvifruta rimmon, shenehem maalu. rabbi yehuda omer, baal habbayit lo maal, shehu omer lo, etrog gadol hayiti mevakkesh veheveta li katan vara. natan lo dinar zahav, amar lo have li chaluk, vehalach vehevi lo vishlosha chaluk uvishlosha tallit, shenehem maalu. rabbi yehuda omer, baal habbayit lo maal, shehu omer lo, chaluk gadol hayiti mevakkesh veheveta li katan vara:
6.5: Hammafkid maot etzel hashshulchani, im tzerurin, lo yishtammesh bahem. lefichach, im hotzi, maal. im muttarim, yishtammesh bahen. lefichach, im hotzi, lo maal. etzel baal habbayit, ben kach uven kach, lo yishtammesh bahem. lefichach, im hotzi, maal. hachenvani kevaal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, keshulchani:
6.6: Peruta shel hekdesh shennafla letoch hakkis, o sheamar, peruta vechis ze hekdesh, kevan shehotzi et harishona, maal, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkis. mode rabbi akiva beomer peruta min hakkis ze hekdesh, shehu motzi veholech ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkis:
